title: Tax Policy Contract — Payload Schema (SUPERSEDED)
description: SUPERSEDED. This monolithic schema was replaced when tax.policy.v1 was migrated to meta-contract v2. Use: tax.policy.snapshot.schema.json. Kept for historical reference only.

policies.description: Full snapshot of all tax policies active from effective_from onwards.

id.description: Stable identifier for this policy. Referenced in order line items.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code: CL, MX, US, AR, UY, BR, PE, VE

region.description: State or region code. Required for US SalesTax. Null for country-wide policies.

tax_type.description: IVA: Chile (19%). IGV: Peru (18%). SalesTax: USA (varies by state/city). Exempt: no tax.

applies_to.description: Item categories subject to this policy. Chile: parts only. Peru: all.

rounding.description: Rounding rule for the computed tax amount

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this policy's country

effective_from.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Policies in this snapshot are valid from this date onwards.
